O.outcome_detail: transfer of imaginary students’ perspectives to subsequent microteaching

cells.quote: The results showed that the combination of the two manipulatives was effective for achieving the immediate transfer of imaginary students’ perspectives.
cells.note: The study describes a quasi-experimental design in which triads and teacher roles were randomly assigned to conditions; no printed effect size is provided in the study text supplied.

cells.quote: Further qualitative analysis enabled by ENA indicated that the perspective-taking manipulatives were effective in bolstering perspective-taking due to the nonverbal aspects of students’ voices enacted in the role-play performances.
cells.note: The qualitative analysis attributed the enhanced perspective-taking to nonverbal aspects of students’ voices enacted during role-play; no printed effect size is provided.
